title: Retraining, Dyslexia, Thesis Hiccups & Making a Difference with Challenging Populations, with Dr Deborah Kingston

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，从那以后，我也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我独家的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森大礼包，以及限时的一对一辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, your guys decide to be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，欢迎来到由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Thank you for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Today, I am joined by a lovely lady by the name of Dr. Deborah Kingston.
sentences.zh: 今天，和我一起的是一位可爱的女士，名叫黛博拉·金斯顿博士。

sentences.en: And we first connected on social media, and it feels like we spent the last couple of years during the pandemic chatting and cheering each other on from the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 我们最初是在社交媒体上认识的，感觉在过去的几年大流行期间，我们一直在聊天，并在场外互相加油。

sentences.en: But today was the first time I've been able to speak with her, you know, one-to-one, actually in real time.
sentences.zh: 但今天是我第一次能够与她进行真正实时的一对一交谈。

sentences.en: And so it felt like a real treat.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉真是一种享受。

sentences.en: I really wanted to invite Deborah on for a variety of reasons,
sentences.zh: 我真的很想邀请黛博拉来，原因有很多，

sentences.en: because I think she has so much that so many of you will be able to resonate and connect with for a variety of reasons, actually.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为她身上有很多东西，你们中的许多人都能在很多方面产生共鸣和联系。

sentences.en: So we are talking about coming to psychology slightly later than average.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要讨论的是比平均年龄稍晚才进入心理学领域。

sentences.en: We are talking about dyslexia.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论阅读障碍。

sentences.en: We are talking about retraining, talking about working in tricky areas, managing tricky situations, mental ill health, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论重新培训，谈论在棘手的领域工作、应对棘手的情况、心理健康不佳，你知道的，

sentences.en: striving for being a psychologist whilst being a parent.
sentences.zh: 在身为父母的同时努力成为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: So we've got it all covered is a punchy, interesting, engaging episode.
sentences.zh: 所以我们涵盖了所有内容，这是一集精彩、有趣且引人入胜的节目。

sentences.en: And I hope you will find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后见。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to this very special episode where I am joined by Dr. Deborah Kingston.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听这个非常特殊的节目，和我在一起的是黛博拉·金斯顿博士。

sentences.en: Deborah, thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉，谢谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用客气。

sentences.en: So you are a fellow clinical psychologist, but your route to clinical psychology may not look like
sentences.zh: 所以你也是一名临床心理学家，但你通往临床心理学之路可能看起来不像

sentences.en: you know, a typical textbook assistant, you know, bit of a master's, get on to doctorate and done.
sentences.zh: 那种典型的教科书式助理经历，比如读个硕士，考上博士就结束了。

sentences.en: Would you like to tell people a little bit about your history?
sentences.zh: 你想跟听众分享一下你的经历吗？

sentences.en: So when I was, well, let's start, I left school, didn't have a GCSE, no qualifications whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 当我，好吧，从头说起，我离开学校时，连一个GCSE证书都没有，没有任何资格证书。

sentences.en: I was told I was a little bit thick and incapable of learning.
sentences.zh: 我被告知我有点笨，没有学习能力。

sentences.en: I think that's what one of the teachers said to my parents on a parent's evening.
sentences.zh: 我想这是其中一位老师在家长会上对我父母说的。

sentences.en: So I decided to join the RAF.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定加入英国皇家空军。

sentences.en: And that was my escapism from home and a life that really wasn't going to offer much opportunities.
sentences.zh: 那是我逃避家庭以及一个真正无法提供什么机会的生活的方式。

sentences.en: So I joined the RAF aged 17 and did quite well.
sentences.zh: 所以我17岁加入了皇家空军，表现得相当不错。

sentences.en: But it was during my RAF career that I started to get educated.
sentences.zh: 但正是在我的皇家空军生涯中，我开始接受教育。

sentences.en: And I was, I worked really hard in the RAF and it was quite male dominated, as you might imagine.
sentences.zh: 我在皇家空军里工作非常努力，你可以想象，那里相当男性化。

sentences.en: And it was really hard to kind of get ahead in a little bit of a way.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，想要崭露头角真的很艰难。

sentences.en: But I still, I did really well.
sentences.zh: 但我还是做得很好。

sentences.en: I got promoted, but I did accountancy.
sentences.zh: 我晋升了，但我做的是会计工作。

sentences.en: So I was a catering accountant.
sentences.zh: 所以我是一名餐饮会计。

sentences.en: I dealt with a lot of numbers.
sentences.zh: 我处理很多数字。

sentences.en: I dealt with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我处理很多人际关系。

sentences.en: I dealt with a lot of problems because drinking and the RAF problems, people would always come to our boss.
sentences.zh: 我处理很多问题，因为酗酒和皇家空军的问题，人们总是来找我们老板。

sentences.en: And I'd be like the gatekeeper to the boss to go talk to him.
sentences.zh: 而我就像是老板的守门人，负责去跟他沟通。

sentences.en: So I really had this flair for chatting to people, which I quite liked.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很擅长跟人聊天，我挺喜欢这样的。

sentences.en: And then in 2003, I became quite poorly with my mental health.
sentences.zh: 然后在2003年，我的心理健康出了严重问题。

sentences.en: You know, severely being bullied by a senior rank who, you know, a lot of ganging up and stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，遭到高级军官的严重欺凌，各种拉帮结派之类的。

sentences.en: And the medics just wanted to medicate me and said antidepressants for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 医疗人员只想给我开药，说余生都要靠抗抑郁药度过。

sentences.en: You know, there you go.
sentences.zh: 就这样吧。

sentences.en: And it was during my time off sick, I helped one of my friends do a psychology module for their social work course.
sentences.zh: 正是在我病假期间，我帮我的一个朋友完成了她社会工作课程的一个心理学模块。

sentences.en: And it just felt like this was an easy thing to be doing for her.
sentences.zh: 感觉为她做这件事轻而易举。

sentences.en: Like, and she'd failed it.
sentences.zh: 而且她还挂科了。

sentences.en: So she'd come say, I failed this module.
sentences.zh: 所以她跑来说，我这个模块挂科了。

sentences.en: I need to redo it.
sentences.zh: 我需要重修。

sentences.en: I'm really struggling.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得很挣扎。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, yeah, but, you know, this one says this.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，哦，是的，但是，你知道，这个上面是这么说的。

sentences.en: And this is really exciting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And this is really good.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒。

sentences.en: And it was like a real flair.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种真正的天赋。

sentences.en: And I had been doing a business degree.
sentences.zh: 我之前一直在修商务学位。

sentences.en: So I was only two modules short of my BA in business studies.
sentences.zh: 所以我只差两个模块就能拿到商务研究文学士学位了。

sentences.en: And it was then she said, have you thought about doing psychology?
sentences.zh: 正是在那时她说，你有没有考虑过学心理学？

sentences.en: So I called the Open University, which, again, is not a conventional route for clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 于是我打电话给英国开放大学，这对于临床心理学家来说同样不是一条常规途径。

sentences.en: And I joined the OU and I did my first course.
sentences.zh: 我加入了开放大学并上了我的第一门课。

sentences.en: And luckily for me,
sentences.zh: 对我幸运的是，

sentences.en: there was a lady that had left Cambridge University and moved up to the north of Scotland and had a little freehold and just wanted to do a little bit of teaching.
sentences.zh: 有一位女士离开剑桥大学搬到了苏格兰北部，拥有一个小庄园，只想做一点教学工作。

sentences.en: On my second essay, she wrote at the bottom, come see me after lecture.
sentences.zh: 在我的第二篇论文上，她在底部写道：讲座结束后找我一下。

sentences.en: This subject's not for you.
sentences.zh: 这个主题不适合你。

sentences.en: I was like, she told me in that lecture I was amazing last time.
sentences.zh: 我想，她上次在讲座中还说我很棒呢。

sentences.en: And I was, like, really conflicted.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很纠结。

sentences.en: And then when I went to see her at the end, she's like, no, no, Deborah, I don't need to see you.
sentences.zh: 然后当我在最后去找她时，她说，不，不，黛博拉，我不需要找你。

sentences.en: Really good lecture again.
sentences.zh: 讲座又讲得很好。

sentences.en: And I'm like, whoa, you're confusing me now.
sentences.zh: 我说，哇，你现在把我搞糊涂了。

sentences.en: And I pulled these essays out and I said, because you've wrote this.
sentences.zh: 我掏出这些论文说，因为你写了这个。

sentences.en: And she's like, oh, my God, why don't you just tell me you were dyslexic and we could have sorted something out.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦天哪，你为什么不早点告诉我你有阅读障碍，我们本可以解决的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, do what?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么？

sentences.en: And she's like, how has nobody pointed out to you that you are severely dyslexic?
sentences.zh: 她说，怎么会没有人指出你患有严重的阅读障碍？

sentences.en: And I was like, well, they just said I was thick.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，他们只说我很笨。

sentences.en: And she's like, no, you can clearly tell by your verbal ability.
sentences.zh: 她说，不，从你的口头表达能力明显能看出。

sentences.en: You know your stuff, but your written ability is just so poor.
sentences.zh: 你懂这些东西，但你的书面表达能力实在太差了。

sentences.en: We just need to get you some software and some techniques and that'll make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要给你弄一些软件和技巧，那就会改变现状。

sentences.en: And I went from basically going from a thank you for coming degree to 5% off a firSt.
sentences.zh: 我的成绩基本上从“谢谢光临”式的学位直接跃升到距离一等学位只差5%。

sentences.en: That's all there was at the end.
sentences.zh: 最终结果就是这样。

sentences.en: And I got a high 2 on, really pleased with it.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了一个不错的二等上一等学位，非常满意。

sentences.en: To be honest, I didn't even know then I was going to become a clinical psychologist because every single time we went to an open university thing,
sentences.zh: 老实说，那时我甚至不知道自己会成为一名临床心理学家，因为每次我们去开放大学的活动时，

sentences.en: they said to you, if you're over 30, you're too old to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们都会对你说，如果你超过30岁，你就太老了，当不成临床心理学家。

sentences.en: If you're just doing your degree now and you're over 30, rule out becoming a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在才开始读学位而且已经超过30岁了，那就别想当临床心理学家了。

sentences.en: Because clinical psychologist, you go A-levels, you go degree, you do some work experience, you do a master's, you get an assistant post, you go on the doctorate course,
sentences.zh: 因为临床心理学家，你要读A-level，读学位，做点工作经验，读个硕士，找个助理岗位，然后上博士课程，

sentences.en: that's your route.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的路线。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, God, I'm not just over 30, I'm well into 30.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，天哪，我不只是刚过30岁，我已经三十好几快奔四了。

sentences.en: So I was like, okay, anyway, I started working an admin job in the NHS, which I turned clinical a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，好吧，不管怎样，我在国民保健署（NHS）找了一份行政工作，我稍微把它做成了一份临床工作。

sentences.en: I did some audits and I did some clinical interviewing for the audit and then I published the audit because I wanted to try and then somebody said,
sentences.zh: 我做了一些审计，并为审计做了一些临床访谈，然后我发表了那项审计结果，因为我想尝试一下，接着有人说，

sentences.en: come get an assistant job, but you need to like have some experience.
sentences.zh: 来找个助理的工作吧，但你需要有一些经验。

sentences.en: And then I took the risk and left my full time paid job with a mortgage and two kids and jumped ship to a six month fixed term assistant psychology post with less money.
sentences.zh: 然后我冒了险，辞去了全职带薪工作，放弃了按揭贷款和两个孩子，跳槽到了一份薪水较少、为期六个月的固定期限心理学助理岗位。

sentences.en: And I thought, I've got to do it, got to do it.
sentences.zh: 我想，我必须这么做，一定要这么做。

sentences.en: And then I started that job in chronic fatigue services, a brilliant psychologist headed up that service.
sentences.zh: 然后我在慢性疲劳服务中心开始了那份工作，一位杰出的心理学家领导着那个部门。

sentences.en: But it was only six months, she said, we can't do any more after that.
sentences.zh: 但那只有六个月，她说，那之后我们无法续签了。

sentences.en: And then I got another job in forensics in the same trust, but again, only six months.
sentences.zh: 接着我在同一个信托基金的法医部门找到了另一份工作，但同样只有六个月。

sentences.en: And it was there I really studied to apply for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，我真正开始努力申请博士学位。

sentences.en: You know, when I did, oh, I missed a bit.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我做，哦，漏掉了一段。

sentences.en: I did an honorary assistant psychology job in the evening after my admin job all day in a learning disability unit with challenging behavior.
sentences.zh: 我在全职行政工作下班后的晚上，在一家针对具有挑战性行为的心理障碍病房做了一份荣誉心理学助理工作。

sentences.en: And the year before, my supervisor had asked me to do the doctorate form.
sentences.zh: 前一年，我的导师曾让我填写博士申请表。

sentences.en: And I had been like, okay, I'll do it.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，好吧，我会填的。

sentences.en: And then when I went to my next supervision with him, he said, where is it?
sentences.zh: 然后当我去找他进行下一次督导时，他说，表呢？

sentences.en: I said, it went in the shredder and it was the most cathartic experience ever because I could see the gaps I didn't have, which is what they mean.
sentences.zh: 我说，它进碎纸机了。那是我经历过最宣泄的体验，因为我能看出我所不具备的差距，而这正是他们的意思。

sentences.en: He said, take the risk, go fix them.
sentences.zh: 他说，承担风险，去弥补它们。

sentences.en: So I did that.
sentences.zh: 所以我照做了。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, I applied for the doctorate thinking go for feedback because nobody gets on the doctorate first time or it's quite rare.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，我申请了博士学位，心想去争取些反馈意见吧，因为没有人能一次就考上博士，或者这相当罕见。

sentences.en: The Trent course is quite grueling.
sentences.zh: 特伦特课程相当折磨人。

sentences.en: Like really grueling.
sentences.zh: 真的是极其折磨人。

sentences.en: And I thought I'll go for the feedback.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我是去获取反馈的。

sentences.en: But I made sure I studied every night in prep for that interview just so I could give myself the best shot.
sentences.zh: 但我确保为那次面试每天晚上都努力复习，只为了给自己最好的机会。

sentences.en: And that year they dropped the places from 20 to 19 and I was first reserved for a place.
sentences.zh: 那一年，他们将名额从20个削减到19个，而我是候补第一名。

sentences.en: And that's how I got.
sentences.zh: 这就是我被录取的方式。

sentences.en: That's from the RAF, different things, onto the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 就是这样，从皇家空军，经历各种事情，最终读上了博士。

sentences.en: That's incredible, Deborah.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了，黛博拉。

sentences.en: And actually a real few magic moments there, you know, the moment of discovering accidentally, you know, psychology degree, really.
sentences.zh: 实际上，那里有很多神奇的时刻，你知道，偶然发现心理学学位的时刻，真的。

sentences.en: And then being told you're dyslexic and, I don't know, it feels like potentially lots of things suddenly might have added up and, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后被告知你有阅读障碍，我不知道，感觉突然有很多事情都能说得通了，你知道的，

sentences.en: ends came together that really gave you important answers.
sentences.zh: 各种线索汇聚在一起，真正为你提供了重要的答案。

sentences.en: And then, of course, I think telling you that you can't do something, I think it's probably similar to telling me that you can't do something.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，我认为告诉某人你做不到某事，这可能和我被告知做不到某事时差不多。

sentences.en: It's always really difficult.
sentences.zh: 这总是非常艰难。

sentences.en: It's like, well, I'll show you, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像是在说，好吧，我会证明给你们看，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I really try and being, because, you know, also on the doctorate course, I'm the only person on the Trent course to actually submit two full theses.
sentences.zh: 我真的努力去尝试，因为，你知道，在博士课程中，我也是特伦特课程中唯一一个实际提交了两份完整学位论文的人。

sentences.en: Because, and they failed my thesis on a technicality of one word, which my tutor had actually changed my research question with me.
sentences.zh: 因为，他们因为一个词的技术细节判定我的论文不合格，而我的导师其实才刚跟我一起改过我的研究问题。

sentences.en: And they failed me on that question.
sentences.zh: 他们就因为那个问题判我不过。

sentences.en: And they said I had to do a brand new thesis from scratch.
sentences.zh: 他们说我必须从头开始做一个全新的论文。

sentences.en: And they thought I'd resign.
sentences.zh: 他们以为我会放弃。

sentences.en: They thought I'd come off the call because I wouldn't want, I wouldn't have had time to do another thesis.
sentences.zh: 他们以为我会退学，因为我不会愿意，也没有时间再做另一篇论文了。

sentences.en: And I turned that thesis around in 13 months from idea to ethics.
sentences.zh: 我从构思到伦理审批，在13个月内把那篇论文赶出来了。

sentences.en: Well, I didn't need ethics, still said to put it through.
sentences.zh: 哦，我其实不需要伦理审批，他们还是让我走了一遍流程。

sentences.en: 13 months, start to finish.
sentences.zh: 13个月，从头到尾。

sentences.en: And it, but I put, you know, I went up to like nearly 15 stone.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的体重一度飙升到了近15英石（约95公斤）。

sentences.en: I was very heavy.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常胖。

sentences.en: You know, my husband was away in the RAF.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我丈夫当时在皇家空军服役。

sentences.en: He did, he did the Libya campaign.
sentences.zh: 他参加了利比亚军事行动。

sentences.en: He's done Afghanistan during that time.
sentences.zh: 在此期间他还去过阿富汗。

sentences.en: You know, he did Iraq prior to that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在此之前他还去过伊拉克。

sentences.en: So the four years I was on my doctorate course, I think he probably only spent about 200 days of that four years at home.
sentences.zh: 所以在攻读博士学位的四年里，我想他在这四年的时间里大概只在家里待了200天左右。

sentences.en: In that four years.
sentences.zh: 就在那四年里。

sentences.en: And I had a, and I had a child to look after.
sentences.zh: 而我还要照顾一个孩子。

sentences.en: My eldest had moved out and it was just, it was, it was a difficult time, but it's well worth it.
sentences.zh: 我的大儿子已经搬出去了，总之，那是一段艰难的时期，但非常值得。

sentences.en: That's what I do now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我现在的感受。

sentences.en: That said, it really shows what we're doing to our aspiring psychologists, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这真正展示了我们对那些怀揣梦想的心理学家们的要求，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, because we are trying to live lives at the same time.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为我们在努力同时过好各自的生活。

sentences.en: And it is a gruelling process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其折磨的过程。

sentences.en: You know, there is many different plates that you're having to spin at that time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那时候你得同时转动很多不同的盘子。

sentences.en: You know, you had the additional, I was going to say complication, but let's say, let's say additional joy of being a mother.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你还要面对额外的——本来我想说是麻烦，但我们不妨说是，不妨说是身为人母的额外喜悦。

sentences.en: Oh, no, seriously, it felt like a complication at the time.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，说真的，当时感觉就像个大麻烦。

sentences.en: Because nobody else on my course had children.
sentences.zh: 因为我课程里没有别人有孩子。

sentences.en: Well, there was only one other lady that had children.
sentences.zh: 好吧，只有另一位女士有孩子。

sentences.en: And she, she also found being a mother quite challenging.
sentences.zh: 而且她，她也觉得当母亲相当具有挑战性。

sentences.en: You know, the rest, not even all of them were married.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，剩下的人，甚至都不是全都结了婚。

sentences.en: You know, they didn't have that juggling act.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们没有那种手忙脚乱的应接不暇。

sentences.en: And I think we are, you know, sometimes when you see these assistants desperate to get on a course and celebrate and they've got on a course.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我们，你知道的，有时当你看到这些助理迫切地想要进入一门课程并庆祝，而他们真的考上了。

sentences.en: Like, I remember cheering when I got on the course and when I reflected back on it the other week, I was like, really, I don't think I'd be cheering if I knew what I was in for.
sentences.zh: 就像我记得自己考上这门课程时欢呼雀跃，而上周我回想起来时，我就在想，真的，如果我知道等着我的是什么，我想我是不会欢呼的。

sentences.en: Oh, it is.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实如此。

sentences.en: And some courses, I've got to say, are really better than others and more diverse than others.
sentences.zh: 而且我得说，有些课程确实比别的课程要好得多，也比别的课程更多元化。

sentences.en: My course is not.
sentences.zh: 我的课程并非如此。

sentences.en: It was really challenging.
sentences.zh: 这真的极具挑战性。

sentences.en: But they taught me a lot.
sentences.zh: 但他们教了我很多。

sentences.en: Although trying to tell me that I would no longer be dyslexic after I finished the course.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们试图告诉我，等我完成这门课程后，我就不再有读写困难了。

sentences.en: You know, they know something we don't about dyslexia.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们对读写困难的了解有些我们不知道的东西。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: Apparently I was going to do that much reading and writing.
sentences.zh: 显然我将要做那么多的阅读和写作。

sentences.en: I would cure myself of my dyslexia.
sentences.zh: 我能治好我的读写困难。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，真的。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Again, you know, a lot of academic psychologists that teach clinical psychologists, you know, are very different.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，你知道，很多教临床心理学家的学术心理学家，你知道，非常不同。

sentences.en: You know, and I think clinical psychologists then go off to split in different domains.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，而且我认为临床心理学家随后会分流到不同的领域。

sentences.en: You know, some go neuroscience, some go academic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些去搞神经科学，有些去搞学术。

sentences.en: You know, I think I was very much, I wanted to help people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我很坚定，我想要帮助别人。

sentences.en: I wanted to help overcome trauma.
sentences.zh: 我想要帮助人们克服创伤。

sentences.en: Because, you know, for me, being a child, I did a lot of trauma.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，对我来说，作为一个孩子，我经历了很多创伤。

sentences.en: I had a lot of trauma in the RAF.
sentences.zh: 我在英国皇家空军经历了许多创伤。

sentences.en: And I just felt that I could really understand people.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我真的能够理解人。

sentences.en: Not from a book.
sentences.zh: 不是从书本上。

sentences.en: Not from a manual.
sentences.zh: 不是从手册上。

sentences.en: But from actually from some lived experience of just being in services.
sentences.zh: 而是实际上来自于身处部队的一些亲身经历。

sentences.en: There's lots of evidence to suggest, isn't there, that people who've had developmental trauma are more likely to end up in an armed force or in prison as well, you know?
sentences.zh: 有大量证据表明，不是吗，经历过发展性创伤的人更容易最终进入军队或者监狱，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对的，对的。

sentences.en: Well, if you think about the aces, that's very much so.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你想想不良童年经历（ACES），确实非常如此。

sentences.en: But the military does attract people with a lot of developmental trauma.
sentences.zh: 但军队确实会吸引很多有发展性创伤的人。

sentences.en: It gives them a real family.
sentences.zh: 它给了他们一个真正的家庭。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, it gives them a purpose and a structure and boundaries and rules.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它给了他们一个目标、结构、界限和规则。

sentences.en: You know, like I'm early for everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我做什么事都早到。

sentences.en: Like, literally everything.
sentences.zh: 真的，字面意义上的每件事。

sentences.en: I can't be on time because that's late.
sentences.zh: 我无法做到准时，因为那就算迟到。

sentences.en: Because the military teaches that if you're going to do something, you're five minutes early.
sentences.zh: 因为军队教导说，如果你要做一件事，你得提前五分钟到。

sentences.en: Because that then means you're on time.
sentences.zh: 因为那才意味着你准时了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Oh, Deborah, even getting ready for this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，黛博拉，甚至在为这个播客做准备的时候。

sentences.en: I confirmed with you, didn't I?
sentences.zh: 我跟你确认过，对吧？

sentences.en: As I was about to eat my lunch.
sentences.zh: 当时我正准备吃午饭。

sentences.en: And you were like, yep, I'm just making a cup of tea and then I'll be ready.
sentences.zh: 而你说，对呀，我正泡杯茶，然后就准备好了。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh my God, I'm still eating my yogurt.
sentences.zh: 而我说，天哪，我还在吃我的酸奶。

sentences.en: But that's how it goes.
sentences.zh: 但事情就是这样。

sentences.en: That's just, you know, I've been out of the military a lot longer now than I was in it.
sentences.zh: 这只是，你知道的，我离开军队的时间现在比我在里面呆的时间长得多。

sentences.en: You know, I left in 2006.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是2006年离开的。

sentences.en: But, you know, I just, I'm more, I still have some of those ways.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我只是，我更，我身上仍然保留着那些习惯。

sentences.en: I like, if I tell somebody I'm going to do something, I do it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢，如果我告诉别人我要做一件事，我就会做到。

sentences.en: I never break a promise.
sentences.zh: 我从不违背诺言。

sentences.en: I work way too hard because in the military there's a really hard work ethic.
sentences.zh: 我工作极其努力，因为在军队里有一种非常刻苦的工作伦理。

sentences.en: And so I do know that, but sometimes that can also in clinical psychology worlds or in, that's not what they're used to.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实知道这一点，但有时在临床心理学界或者在其他地方，这并不是他们习惯的。

sentences.en: They're not used to somebody like me.
sentences.zh: 他们不习惯像我这样的人。

sentences.en: And again, if you're a little bit different, regardless whether it's sexuality, whether it's color of skin, whether it's class and background, you know, if you're a bit different,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，如果你稍微有点不同，不管是因为性取向、皮肤颜色、阶级还是背景，你知道，如果你有点与众不同，

sentences.en: you're going to really feel the weight of the clinical psychology course sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时你真的会感受到临床心理学课程的分量。

sentences.en: Because it can feel like you don't fit in, that you don't belong there.
sentences.zh: 因为这会让你觉得你格格不入，你不属于那里。

sentences.en: And I was very prickly on my doctorate course.
sentences.zh: 在攻读博士学位期间，我浑身是刺。

sentences.en: I'm not going to lie.
sentences.zh: 我不会撒谎。

sentences.en: I think I probably annoyed a few people at times because I constantly ask questions because I love verbal feedback.
sentences.zh: 我想我有时可能惹恼了一些人，因为我一直在提问，我太喜欢口头反馈了。

sentences.en: Like, I really learn through people talking to me and listening.
sentences.zh: 就像，我真的是通过别人跟我交谈和倾听来学习的。

sentences.en: It's that connection as well, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这也是那种联系，对吧？

sentences.en: Often in teaching, you don't have the same connection.
sentences.zh: 通常在教学中，你没有那种深度的联系。

sentences.en: It's not personal.
sentences.zh: 这不是私人的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And I just needed it.
sentences.zh: 而我就是需要这个。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of people want it to be silent and thinkers.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很多人希望保持安静并成为思考者。

sentences.en: Or just get in and get finished early to go to the pub or just go and lay and do nothing.
sentences.zh: 或者只是参与其中然后早点结束去酒吧，或者只是去躺着什么都不做。

sentences.en: I think sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时我想是的。

sentences.en: There was probably some of them too, yeah.
sentences.zh: 他们当中可能也有这样的人，对。

sentences.en: But that's not me.
sentences.zh: 但那不是我。

sentences.en: I'm always like, well, I need to learn this more.
sentences.zh: 我总是觉得，嗯，我需要更多地学习这个。

sentences.en: And I still, like, I do so much CPD now.
sentences.zh: 而且我仍然，比如，我现在做了这么多的持续专业发展（CPD）学习。

sentences.en: Like, I'm always on a CPD course.
sentences.zh: 就像，我总是在参加CPD课程。

sentences.en: My husband's constantly saying, what, another course?
sentences.zh: 我丈夫经常说，什么，又是一门课？

sentences.en: Why do we need another course?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们需要另一门课？

sentences.en: And I'm like, I need to know more.
sentences.zh: 而我说，我需要了解更多。

sentences.en: Because what if I don't know enough?
sentences.zh: 因为如果我知道得不够怎么办？

sentences.en: What if I don't know it?
sentences.zh: 如果我不知道该怎么办怎么办？

sentences.en: What if a client sits in front of me and I don't know what to do?
sentences.zh: 如果一个来访者坐在我面前而我不知道该做什么怎么办？

sentences.en: It's like, you do really well then.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，那你后来做得真的很棒。

sentences.en: What's your advice to our audience if they are feeling that imposter syndrome?
sentences.zh: 如果我们的听众也感到了这种冒名顶替综合征，你对他们有什么建议？

sentences.en: They've got that worry that someone's going to ask them something that they don't know.
sentences.zh: 他们担心别人会问他们一些他们不知道的问题。

sentences.en: Well, do you know what?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道吗？

sentences.en: When I was on my third year of my course, my supervisor had said, ask me a question that there was no answer to.
sentences.zh: 当我读到课程第三年的时候，我的督导曾说过，问我一个没有答案的问题。

sentences.en: And I really, really struggled to say the words, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常非常艰难地才说出“我不知道”这几个字。

sentences.en: They literally choked in my throat as I was scrambling in my head for the answer.
sentences.zh: 当我在脑海里搜寻答案时，这几个字简直卡在了我的喉咙里。

sentences.en: And I couldn't just say to her, look, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我就是无法对她说，听着，我不知道。

sentences.en: I'll go check and I'll come back and see you.
sentences.zh: 我去查一下，然后再来找你。

sentences.en: I literally froze on the spot in that imposter syndrome moment.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻陷入冒名顶替综合征的时候，我简直僵在了原地。

sentences.en: And I'm like, she's found me out kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我心里想，她差不多已经把我的底看穿了。

sentences.en: And she's like, Deborah, I've asked you a question.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，黛博拉，我问了你一个问题。

sentences.en: There is no answer to it.
sentences.zh: 这个问题没有答案。

sentences.en: I was like, why would you do that?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，你为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: She said, because you have to learn to say, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 她说，因为你必须学会说“我不知道”。

sentences.en: And I don't know can be okay.
sentences.zh: 而且“我不知道”是可以没事的。

sentences.en: And I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，什么？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: I don't know can be okay.
sentences.zh: “我不知道”是可以没事的。

sentences.en: My chest in that moment felt like it was literally crushing.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我的胸口感觉像被压碎了一样。

sentences.en: I was like, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 我在想，你这是什么意思？

sentences.en: I don't know is okay.
sentences.zh: 说“我不知道”是没事的。

sentences.en: We're meant to know the answer.
sentences.zh: 我们本该知道答案的。

sentences.en: This is what they're paying us for.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们付钱给我们的原因。

sentences.en: And she's like, no, they're not.
sentences.zh: 而她说，不，他们不是这个意思。

sentences.en: They're paying for you to then go away and think about it.
sentences.zh: 他们付钱是为了让你随后去思考这件事。

sentences.en: Come back to them.
sentences.zh: 然后再回复他们。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哦。

sentences.en: So that's now when I don't know something and somebody asked me something, I genuinely don't know it.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，当我不懂某事而别人问我问题，我是真的不知道的时候，

sentences.en: It took me a long time to say, I can just say I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我花了很长时间才学会说，我可以说我不知道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So you can sit with that now and be okay with that.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在可以坦然面对这一点，并对此泰然处之了。

sentences.en: But if people can get there quicker with that, it'll save them a whole host of worry and hassle.
sentences.zh: 但如果人们能更快地接受这一点，就能省去一大堆的担忧和麻烦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So where did you end up working when you first qualified then?
sentences.zh: 那你刚毕业拿到资格时，最后去哪里工作了呢？

sentences.en: What did you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: I got a job at Lincoln Prison.
sentences.zh: 我在林肯监狱找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: And I absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: I was finishing my thesis.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在完成我的毕业论文。

sentences.en: I didn't quite have my doctor's title.
sentences.zh: 我还没有拿到我的博士头衔。

sentences.en: All the banding.
sentences.zh: 没有对应的薪级。

sentences.en: All the pay.
sentences.zh: 没有对应的薪水。

sentences.en: But that's okay.
sentences.zh: 但这没关系。

sentences.en: I absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 我真的超级喜欢。

sentences.en: I went in there and the guys at Lincoln Prison were amazing.
sentences.zh: 我走进去，林肯监狱的那些小伙子们太棒了。

sentences.en: I set up a trauma-informed work group for both prisoners in the vulnerable prison wing and then the other wings because you had to keep them very separate.
sentences.zh: 我为弱势监狱区和其他监区的囚犯建立了一个创伤知情工作小组，因为你必须把他们严格分开。

sentences.en: And initially the prison thought we'd only do a group for one type of population, not for both.
sentences.zh: 最初监狱认为我们只会为一种人群设立一个小组，而不是兼顾两类。

sentences.en: And I just felt like both populations really needed it because the one thing we found, like you said earlier, the majority of people that end up in prison have had
sentences.zh: 而我只是觉得这两类人群真的很需要它，因为正如你刚才所说，我们发现绝大多数最终进监狱的人都有过

sentences.en: a developmental trauma.
sentences.zh: 发展性创伤。

sentences.en: But the one biggest thing I found through working there was nobody recognized those guys as victiMs.
sentences.zh: 但我在那里工作发现的最大的一点是，没有人把这些家伙当作受害者来看待。

sentences.en: It was heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 这太让人心碎了。

sentences.en: Some of their stories, Marianne, were really, really heartbreaking in terms of the abuse they suffered, the neglect they suffered, and the fact that nobody cared until they pitched
sentences.zh: 玛丽安，他们的一些经历真的是非常非常让人心碎，关于他们遭受的虐待、遭受的忽视，以及直到他们闯入

sentences.en: up in the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 刑事司法系统之前都没有人关心这一事实。

sentences.en: And then there was more a big stick approach than a trauma-led approach.
sentences.zh: 然后，比起创伤主导的方法，更多的是一种大棒政策的方法。

sentences.en: And it was through group work and eventually EMDR that the guys I worked with really started to notice their own victim status and how they needed that to heal.
sentences.zh: 正是通过小组工作以及后来的眼动脱敏再加工（EMDR），和我一起工作的那些小伙子们才真正开始注意到他们自己的受害者身份以及他们如何需要这种身份来疗愈。

sentences.en: But in doing that, they noticed that they created victiMs.
sentences.zh: 但在这样做的过程中，他们注意到他们也制造了受害者。

sentences.en: And, you know, the prisoners put on these victim empathy courses that supposedly teach them how to have victim empathy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，囚犯们参加这些受害者同理心课程，据称这些课程教导他们如何具备受害者同理心。

sentences.en: But unless they truly get to the roots of their own trauma, they have to defend the fact that they've got victims because it will just make them feel more vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 但除非他们真正触及自身创伤的根源，否则他们必须为自己拥有受害者这一事实进行辩护，因为这只会让他们感到更加脆弱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So a lot of the...
sentences.zh: 所以很多...

sentences.en: You've really joined up that compassion, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 你真的把这种同情心完美地结合起来了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's what you've done.
sentences.zh: 你就是这么做的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But then they started to spread my job a bit thin.
sentences.zh: 但后来他们的工作开始把我分得太散了。

sentences.en: So I had to then cover Lincoln and Nottingham.
sentences.zh: 所以我后来不得不兼顾林肯和诺丁汉。

sentences.en: And then Lincoln, Nottingham, North Sea Camp, the open prison.
sentences.zh: 然后是林肯、诺丁汉、北海营，也就是那个开放式监狱。

sentences.en: And then it was Lincoln, Nottingham, North Sea Camp and Morton Hall, the Immigration Removal
sentences.zh: 接着又是林肯、诺丁汉、北海营以及莫顿霍尔移民遣返

sentences.en: Centre.
sentences.zh: 中心。

sentences.en: Now that, again, was quite harrowing.
sentences.zh: 现在，那段经历再次让人感到相当痛苦。

sentences.en: Seeing people dragged in because they had failed to complete a form in time or were deemed to be a risk.
sentences.zh: 看到人们因为没有及时填完表格或者被认为有风险而被粗暴地拖进来。

sentences.en: Now, yes, if you commit a crime over a certain length of time, apparently you then are likely to be deported.
sentences.zh: 现在，是的，如果你犯了超过一定刑期的罪，显然你接下来就很可能会被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: However, there was a lot of people in that immigration centre who had not committed a crime, who had come here for what they thought was a better life.
sentences.zh: 然而，那个移民中心里有许多人并没有犯罪，他们来这里是为了他们所认为的更好的生活。

sentences.en: Their journeys were terribly, terribly distressing from leaving their country of origin and their
sentences.zh: 他们的旅程极其极其痛苦，他们离开了祖国和家里的

sentences.en: family at home and being almost imprisoned because they tried to find work and do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 亲人，仅仅因为试图寻找工作并做正确的事，就几乎像囚犯一样被关起来。

sentences.en: And even some of the issues, like the idea of sending somebody back to a country that was homosexual, which would have led to their death.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一些问题，比如把某人送回一个同性恋会被判死刑的国家。

sentences.en: You know, I just thought, no, that's not the society.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时就想，不，这不是这个社会该有的样子。

sentences.en: So I felt like I had a real fight for them.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉我必须为他们好好抗争一番。

sentences.en: So, you know, I wanted to get their voice heard within that system, within that home office system.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我想在这个体制内，在内政部的体制内，让他们的声音被听到。

sentences.en: So, again, in that place, I did teachings for home office staff around trauma and the impact
sentences.zh: 所以，同样是在那个地方，我为内政部员工做过关于创伤以及创伤影响的

sentences.en: of trauma because they'd say, well, they didn't tell me that on the first, I didn't hear that.
sentences.zh: 培训，因为他们会说，嗯，他们在第一次的时候没有告诉我这些，我没听到。

sentences.en: They haven't told me that.
sentences.zh: 他们没有跟我说过这个。

sentences.en: So, therefore, they're lying to you.
sentences.zh: 所以，因此，他们是在对你撒谎。

sentences.en: And I'm like, why do you think they might not have been able to tell you about their most traumatic experience?
sentences.zh: 而我会说，为什么你们觉得他们可能无法向你们讲述他们最具创伤的经历呢？

sentences.en: And, you know, so we do some work on what was your interview skill like?
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，所以我们做了一些工作，看看你们的面试技巧是怎样的？

sentences.en: How did you present to them?
sentences.zh: 你们是怎么向他们展现自己的？

sentences.en: Did you make them feel safe in the room?
sentences.zh: 你们有让他们在房间里感到安全吗？

sentences.en: And they're like, it's not my job to make them feel safe.
sentences.zh: 而他们的反应是，让这些人感到安全不是我的工作。

sentences.en: And some of the immigration removal officers were brilliant and they'd get all that information.
sentences.zh: 不过有些移民遣返官员非常优秀，他们能收集到所有的信息。

sentences.en: It's the same as prison officers.
sentences.zh: 这和监狱管教是一样的。

sentences.en: Prison officers would say prisoners were needy and manipulative and they always choose the soft officers.
sentences.zh: 监狱管教们会说囚犯事多又爱操纵人，而且他们总是挑心软的管教下手。

sentences.en: And I said, and I remember saying to an officer one day, he said, am I being manipulated?
sentences.zh: 我说，我记得有一天我对一个管教说，他说，我是在被人操纵吗？

sentences.en: And I said, who would you go to on this wing right now if you had a problem?
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你现在遇到问题，你会去找这个监区的谁？

sentences.en: Which officer would you select?
sentences.zh: 你会选哪个管教？

sentences.en: And he named them.
sentences.zh: 然后他报出了他们的名字。

sentences.en: And I said, why is your behavior then not deemed to be manipulative, but their behavior is when they choose the same officers?
sentences.zh: 我说，那为什么当他们选择同样的管教时，他们的行为不被认为是操纵，而你的行为却是呢？

sentences.en: And so I did a lot of psychoeducation around that.
sentences.zh: 所以我围绕这一点做了大量的心理教育工作。

sentences.en: I thought that was really important.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的非常重要。

sentences.en: And it was a shame because the prison employed somebody to come in and be the boss of therapy
sentences.zh: 真遗憾，监狱雇来担任治疗服务主管的人居然没有任何治疗经验，不是临床心理学家，

sentences.en: services who had no therapy experience, wasn't a clinical psychologist, didn't meet these essential criteria and then called me IAPT and told me I was to stop working with patients
sentences.zh: 不符合这些基本标准，然后他还打电话给我，说我是IAPT（英国心理治疗服务机构），并告诉我要停止对患者进行治疗干预，改做桌面分析。

sentences.en: therapeutically, do desktop analysis.
sentences.zh: 当时我就说，不。

sentences.en: And at that point I said, no.
sentences.zh: 如果我不能去见患者并帮助他们，那我就走人。

sentences.en: If I'm not going to see and help patients, I'm leaving.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么后来我们参与其中。

sentences.en: And that's why then we're part of it.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，这真的很艰难，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, it's very difficult, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 因为我知道，你知道，这项工作对我们作为临床医生和普通人来说意义重大。

sentences.en: Because I know, you know, this work matters deeply to us as clinicians and humans.
sentences.zh: 当我们觉得能够建立那种人际连接，哪怕只为一个人带来改变时，

sentences.en: And when we feel we can get that human connection and make a difference even for one person, it's
sentences.zh: 这种感觉是难以置信的，充满力量的，它会让你即使在棘手的日子里也愿意继续工作。

sentences.en: incredible and it's powerful and it keeps you coming back to work even on tricky days.
sentences.zh: 但一旦有人挡了道，你知道的，我想这就是那种道德损伤的概念吧？

sentences.en: But once someone gets in the way of, you know, I think it's that idea of moral injury, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 而我并不愿意以那种方式工作。

sentences.en: And I'm not willing to work in that way.
sentences.zh: 眼睁睁看着这一切发生却什么也做不了，这对我来说其实更具挑战性，如果我们留下来，这本身就会在我们心里变成一种创伤。

sentences.en: And that's actually more challenging to me to watch that go by and have and not be able to do anything that becomes a trauma in itself for ourselves if we stay.
sentences.zh: 然后你就要面临这样的决定：是离开一份你热爱的工作和一个你深爱的客户群体，因为我再也不能同流合污了。

sentences.en: And you're then left with the decision of leaving a job that you love and a client population that you love very much because I can't be party to it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不能只是去走个过场，而是要去真正帮助人们。

sentences.en: I can't just go in and help people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有多少次走进监区，穿行而过，只是陪在某人身边，帮他们平复情绪。

sentences.en: You know, the amount of times I would go on a wing, walk through and just stand with somebody and ground them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有一次去诺丁汉，临时换了班，仅仅是因为我不得不去。

sentences.en: You know, I went to Nottingham once and I changed days just because I had to.
sentences.zh: 当我走进去时，我听说我的一个病人爬上了防坠网，他们正叫国家应急小组来把他弄下来。

sentences.en: And as I walked in, I heard that one of my patients was on the netting and they were calling in the national team to get him off.
sentences.zh: 我溜达着走到了那个监区。

sentences.en: And I wandered up to the wing.
sentences.zh: 你能给我们解释一下那是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: Can you tell us what that means?
sentences.zh: 给我们描绘一下“在防坠网上”是什么画面。

sentences.en: Paint us a picture of what on the netting means.
sentences.zh: 在每个监狱里，当你走上楼梯时，每层楼之间都有一张网。

sentences.en: In each prison, as you go up the steps, there's a net between each floor.
sentences.zh: 这样就不会有人失足掉落并摔到最底层。

sentences.en: So somebody can't fall and land on the bottom floor.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上无法自杀。

sentences.en: So they can't basically commit suicide.
sentences.zh: 但他们待在这个网上，而且其实还是有点危险的。

sentences.en: But they're on this netting and it's still a little bit dangerous.
sentences.zh: 他们简直就像是被悬挂在空中的网上。

sentences.en: And they're literally suspended in the air on this net.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你从杂技飞人绳索上掉到网里，你通常还能翻身下来。

sentences.en: So if you fall from a trapeze rope onto some netting, you'd normally be able to roll off and get off.
sentences.zh: 但在监狱里，你基本上做不到这一点。

sentences.en: In the prison, you can't really do that.
sentences.zh: 你必须自己挪到边缘，然后爬下来。

sentences.en: You have to then get yourself to the edge and you have to climb off.
sentences.zh: 但监狱管教因为这很危险，所以不会上去把你弄下来。

sentences.en: But prison officers, because it's dangerous, won't go on and get you off.
sentences.zh: 他们不会去被关禁闭。

sentences.en: They won't go get locked up.
sentences.zh: 他们不会回自己的房间。

sentences.en: They won't go back to their room.
sentences.zh: 他们不会按被要求的那样去做。

sentences.en: They won't do what they're being told to do.
sentences.zh: 所以监狱管教们已经陪着玩这出猫鼠游戏好几个小时了。

sentences.en: So the prison officers have been doing this merry dance for a few hours now.
sentences.zh: 他在网上待了那么久。

sentences.en: He's been on the netting.
sentences.zh: 他就是不肯下来。

sentences.en: He's not coming off.
sentences.zh: 他就在正中间。

sentences.en: He's right in the centre.
sentences.zh: 所以我走过去，他看到我的表情就像是在说，不。

sentences.en: And so I go in and he sees my face as if saying, no.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是一种自杀行为。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily an act of suicidality.
sentences.zh: 这是一种“我真的不想见任何人”的行为。

sentences.en: It's an act of, I really don't want to be around anyone.
sentences.zh: 我不想做你们让我做的事。

sentences.en: I don't want to do what you want me to do.
sentences.zh: 不，我才不要做。

sentences.en: No, I don't want to do.
sentences.zh: 但同时他也知道自己会挨揍，因为国家应急小组会冲进来，把他从网上粗暴地拉扯下来，然后把他扔进隔离区。

sentences.en: But also he knew he would get a kick in because the national team would come in and manhandle him off there and put him down to segregation.
sentences.zh: 这样他就能独自待在隔离区的一个房间里，远离这一切烦恼。

sentences.en: So he'd get to be alone in a room in segregation away from all of it.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，这种行为是有“功能”的……

sentences.en: So it was functional in the fact that...
sentences.zh: 哦，这就像托儿所里那种最基本的行为，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, it's like basic behaviour in nurseries, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这完全说得通。

sentences.en: It makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 他需要降低刺激。

sentences.en: He needed to de-stimulate.
sentences.zh: 周围对他来说太吵闹了。

sentences.en: It was too busy for him.
sentences.zh: 实在是太多了。

sentences.en: It was too much.
sentences.zh: 他崩溃了。

sentences.en: He was overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 他本来也快要刑满释放了。

sentences.en: He was also due to be released.
sentences.zh: 他大概从17岁起就一直在青少年管教所或监狱里。

sentences.en: He'd been in prison on an office since he was like 17.
sentences.zh: 他从来没有真正了解过外面的世界。

sentences.en: He's never really known the outside world.
sentences.zh: 他吓得要死。

sentences.en: He was bloody petrified.
sentences.zh: 在各方面都情绪失调了。

sentences.en: Just dysregulated in every area.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以我走过去对监狱管教说，听着，我要把他弄下来。

sentences.en: So I go on and I say to the prison officers, look, I'm going to get him off here.
sentences.zh: 他们笑了笑说，他从来不会自己下来的。

sentences.en: And they laughed and like, he never comes off.
sentences.zh: 他总是这样，这就是流程。

sentences.en: He gets, this is the process.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我要把他弄下来。

sentences.en: And I said, no, I'm going to get him off.
sentences.zh: 去个小办公室，我只是跟他谈谈。

sentences.en: A little office and I'm going to just talk to him.
sentences.zh: 而这不符合规程。

sentences.en: And that's not protocol.
sentences.zh: 他必须被……

sentences.en: He has to get...
sentences.zh: 不，我心里想，才不呢。

sentences.en: No, I'm like, no.
sentences.zh: 但我不按规程把他弄下来同样也不符合规程。

sentences.en: But neither is me getting him off protocol.
sentences.zh: 我们来试着做点不一样的事吧。

sentences.en: Let's just try to do something different.
sentences.zh: 看看我们能不能避免让他挨揍。

sentences.en: Let's see if we can avoid him getting the kick in.
sentences.zh: 避免他被送进隔离区。

sentences.en: Avoiding going to segregation.
sentences.zh: 看看我能不能让他……

sentences.en: Let's see if I can get him that...
sentences.zh: 就像是，看看我们能不能帮他重新调适情绪。

sentences.en: Like, let's see if we can re-regulate him.
sentences.zh: 看看我们能不能引导他选择一种更具适应性的不同行为。

sentences.en: Let's see if we can get him to choose a different behaviour that's more adaptive.
sentences.zh: 我们就按这个思路来。

sentences.en: Let's go with that idea.
sentences.zh: 所以真的，我走过去站在那里，他看着我说道：

sentences.en: So literally, I walked over and I stood there and he's like,
sentences.zh: 黛比，你在这儿干嘛？

sentences.en: Deb's what you're doing here?
sentences.zh: 黛比，你在这儿干嘛？

sentences.en: Deb's what you're doing here?
sentences.zh: 我说，我是来带你离开那张网的。

sentences.en: And I was like, I've come to get you off the netting.
sentences.zh: 他说，黛比，如果我从上面下来，那些监狱管教或者冲过来的人会立刻揍我一顿的。

sentences.en: He's like, but they'll give me a kick in Deb's if I come off those prison officers or jump on straight away.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我向你保证。

sentences.en: I said, no, I've got the assurance.
sentences.zh: 那种事不会发生的。

sentences.en: That's not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我和你要去办公室，我们要单独在办公室待一个小时。

sentences.en: Me and you are going to go to the office and we're going to have an hour just in the office.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，你保证只要我从网上下来，我们就待满那一个小时。

sentences.en: And he's like, you promise if I come off this netting, we're having that hour.
sentences.zh: 我说，我保证。

sentences.en: And I was like, promise.
sentences.zh: 真的，我得引导他，甚至在他自己翻过栏杆之前，我就先让他去感受手上防坠网的触感，

sentences.en: And literally, I had to get him, even before he could get himself over the bars, I got him just to notice the feel of the netting on his hands,
sentences.zh: 去感受他自己在那里的实体感，去感受与我的连接。

sentences.en: to notice the feel of himself there, to notice the connection with me.
sentences.zh: 然后再过来抓住栏杆，感受一下它们在手上的冰凉触感，让自己先平静下来，然后他才翻过栏杆回到平台，

sentences.en: And then to come and hold on to the bars and notice how cold they felt on his hands and just ground himself before he then flipped himself back over the bars onto the landing,
sentences.zh: 接着沿着平台走过去，走进一个小办公室。

sentences.en: to then walk down the landing to go in a little office.
sentences.zh: 他像个五岁的小男孩一样坐在那个小办公室的地上，

sentences.en: And he sat in that little office on the floor like he was a five-year-old boy,
sentences.zh: 吓得要命，说他们会破门而入的，黛比，他们会……黛比，我不想让你受伤，

sentences.en: petrified, saying that they're going to burst through the doors, Deb, so they're going to, don't want you to get hurt, Deb,
sentences.zh: 所以你离我远点，万一他们破门而入，我不能让你受伤。

sentences.en: so you stay away from me just in case they burst through the doors and I can't have you hurt.
sentences.zh: 我说，他们不会进来的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, they're not coming in.
sentences.zh: 没事的。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 来吧……我帮他平复了情绪，然后我说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Let's, and I got him regulated and I said, but what's this all about?
sentences.zh: 他说，我女朋友写了一封信来，她要和我分手，可我下周就要刑满释放了。

sentences.en: And he said, my girlfriend wrote a letter in and she's breaking up with me and I'm due out next week.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办才好。

sentences.en: I didn't know what else to do.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果我大闹一场，我就会被加刑，然后我就能留在里面了。

sentences.en: So I thought, well, if I create havoc, I'll get extra days and then I might stay in.
sentences.zh: 我说，你真的有那么害怕吗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, are you really that scared?
sentences.zh: 于是我们得以一起梳理，为什么他会如此害怕出狱，以及我们需要为他顺利出狱做哪些准备工作？

sentences.en: So we then were able to process why he was really that scared of being released and what stepping stones did we need to put in place for him to be released safely?
sentences.zh: 所以这真的是一件很美好的事情，但是，我也确实很怀念无法再去从事或做到这些的时候，因为那些客户不会走进

sentences.en: So it was a really, it was a beautiful thing, but, and I do miss not being able to go or do that because those clients aren't going to walk through the door
sentences.zh: 我的私人诊所，这真的很遗憾。

sentences.en: in my private practice, which is a shame.
sentences.zh: 我敢说你依然活在他们的心中，这就是我们工作不可思议的力量所在。

sentences.en: I bet you still live in their hearts and that's the incredible power about our work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们给我写信了。

sentences.en: Well, they wrote to me.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有些人给我写了信。

sentences.en: Some of them wrote to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我收到过画作，收到过手写信。

sentences.en: You know, I've had drawings, I've had writings.
sentences.zh: 我曾经跟一个家伙合作过八次，他一直叫我混蛋（注：原文see you next Tuesday为C-U-Next-Tuesday的缩写，指代bitch），

sentences.en: I once worked with a guy who called me a see you next Tuesday for eight sessions,
sentences.zh: 撕毁了大量的身份证件，根本不肯配合。

sentences.en: ripped up loads of ID cards, wouldn't work.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天我对他说，听着，在这段改变的旅程中，我需要做你的副驾驶。

sentences.en: And then I said to him one day, look, I need to be your co-driver on this journey of change.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们上这辆车吧。

sentences.en: Like, let's get on this train.
sentences.zh: 让我们做出改变。

sentences.en: Let's make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我来当你的副驾驶，看看我们能做些什么。

sentences.en: I'll be your co-driver and let's see what we can do.
sentences.zh: 他是个曼彻斯特的小伙子。

sentences.en: He's a Manchester lad.
sentences.zh: 他当时在林肯这边。

sentences.en: He was over here in Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们聊起了霍兰德馅饼和莫比面包。

sentences.en: You know, we talked about Holland's pies and Morby's bread.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们聊过荷兰馅饼和莫比面包。

sentences.en: You know, it was something that just helps us connect.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这只是一种有助于我们建立联系的事物。

sentences.en: And if you're from Manchester and Lancashire, you'll know what Holland's pies are.
sentences.zh: 如果你来自曼彻斯特和兰开夏郡，你就会知道什么是霍兰德馅饼。

sentences.en: If you're from anywhere in the country, you might have to Google them.
sentences.zh: 如果你来自这个国家的其他地方，你可能得用谷歌搜索一下它们。

sentences.en: But it was something so simple to him.
sentences.zh: 但对她来说，这是一件如此简单的事情。

sentences.en: And he'd been failed by mental health services in every prison he'd ever been in.
sentences.zh: 而且他在他去过的每一所监狱里，都曾被心理健康服务机构所辜负。

sentences.en: He was hooked on lots of prescription medication.
sentences.zh: 他沉迷于大量的处方药。

sentences.en: You know, he was on the hook, but he had been in and out of prison again since 15, putting this window through this house constantly.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他曾深陷泥潭，但自从15岁起，他就一直进出监狱，不断把这栋房子的窗户砸碎。

sentences.en: And then we did some really good work with him.
sentences.zh: 然后我们和他一起做了一些非常棒的工作。

sentences.en: And he recognized the house that he keeps putting the windows through is the man that abused him.
sentences.zh: 他认出他一直砸碎窗户的那栋房子属于那个虐待过他的人。

sentences.en: But what he'd failed to realize in his head was that man had moved on years ago.
sentences.zh: 但他脑子里没有意识到的是，那个人多年前就已经搬走了。

sentences.en: And it was always new families in that house that he was putting their windows through on.
sentences.zh: 而且他砸碎窗户的那个房子里，住的总是新家庭。

sentences.en: So nobody joined up the dots that he was, this was part of his trauma.
sentences.zh: 所以没有人把这些线索串联起来，意识到这是他创伤的一部分。

sentences.en: And nobody treated his trauma.
sentences.zh: 也没有人治疗他的创伤。

sentences.en: You know, this, this dad had been abused by everybody in his family.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这个，这个父亲曾被他家里的每一个人虐待过。

sentences.en: It was, in fact, it was probably one of the abuse, the most horrible abuse cases I've ever heard.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这可能是虐待案件中，我听过最可怕的虐待案例之一。

sentences.en: And we worked really well together.
sentences.zh: 我们合作得非常愉快。

sentences.en: And then I managed to get him in a drug rehab service over in Manchester.
sentences.zh: 后来我设法把他送进了曼彻斯特的一家戒毒康复机构。

sentences.en: He then wrote to me and said, do you want to come to my graduation?
sentences.zh: 然后他写信给我说，你想来参加我的毕业典礼吗？

sentences.en: Because I'm about to drive my train for myself.
sentences.zh: 因为我马上要自己开火车了。

sentences.en: I no longer need a co-driver, but you're still there.
sentences.zh: 我不再需要副驾驶了，但你依然陪伴在那里。

sentences.en: And it was like...
sentences.zh: 当时的感觉就像是……

sentences.en: Oh, it brings that shivers down my spine.
sentences.zh: 哦，这让我感到不寒而栗。

sentences.en: It's just lovely, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 真是太美妙了，对吧？

sentences.en: How amazing is that?
sentences.zh: 这有多神奇？

sentences.en: Really, really incredible.
sentences.zh: 真的，真的太不可思议了。

sentences.en: You know, for a lad that was never, was never going to end up...
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对于一个本来绝不可能……

sentences.en: It's never been seen before.
sentences.zh: 这真是前所未见。

sentences.en: So to me, that was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，那太美好了。

sentences.en: But I still do some, I do some free work in clinic with some veterans that can't afford private therapy who've been let down by the system.
sentences.zh: 但我仍然在诊所为一些无法承担私人治疗、被体制辜负的退伍军人做一些免费工作。

sentences.en: So, because I am a veteran, they're that big group I tend to, even in the prison, I used to go to the veteran groups.
sentences.zh: 所以，因为我是一名退伍军人，他们是我倾向于关注的大群体，甚至在监狱里，我也经常去退伍军人小组。

sentences.en: You know, the prison officers would go to those veteran groups.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，狱警也会去那些退伍军人小组。

sentences.en: We made, the prison officers would just put a normal jumper on over their uniform kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我们让，狱警们只是在制服外面套一件普通的套头衫之类的。

sentences.en: So they didn't look like prison officers where we all sat around the table.
sentences.zh: 这样他们看起来就不像狱警了，大家围坐在桌旁。

sentences.en: And we'd take biscuits in and we'd have a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 我们会带饼干进去，喝杯茶。

sentences.en: Now, I know tea and biscuits, something like you think, but they don't get them in prison.
sentences.zh: 现在我知道茶和饼干听起来像什么，但他们在监狱里是吃不到这些的。

sentences.en: You know, and it was just that area to like, let's think about this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那只是一个让我们能够思考一下的空间。

sentences.en: Let's just be...
sentences.zh: 让我们只是……

sentences.en: Did you take nice biscuits?
sentences.zh: 你带了好吃的饼干吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, of course I did.
sentences.zh: 对，我当然带了。

sentences.en: When it was my turn, they couldn't have foil on and you couldn't have this.
sentences.zh: 轮到我的时候，饼干不能有锡箔包装，也不能有这个那个的限制。

sentences.en: And you had to decal them out.
sentences.zh: 你必须把包装拆掉。

sentences.en: If they had any foil to them, that's a risk hazard in prison, so you weren't allowed.
sentences.zh: 如果它们带有任何锡箔纸，在监狱里这就是安全隐患，所以是不被允许的。

sentences.en: Yeah, but prison work was amazing.
sentences.zh: 对，但监狱工作太棒了。

sentences.en: So anybody that wants to go to prison, by the way, absolutely 100%.
sentences.zh: 所以顺便说一句，任何想去监狱工作的人，绝对100%支持。

sentences.en: And if you look at the Scotland stuff, they're doing loads on compassionate prisons.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看苏格兰的情况，他们在富有同情心的监狱建设上做了大量工作。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I loved forensic work until I became a mummy.
sentences.zh: 在我成为妈妈之前，我非常热爱法医工作。

sentences.en: And then for me, it just changed the way I felt.
sentences.zh: 然后对我来说，这改变了我的感受。

sentences.en: I felt more vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我感到了更多的脆弱。

sentences.en: But I know lots of people that do work in prisons whilst being a parent as well.
sentences.zh: 但我知道很多人在当父母的同时也在监狱里工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was hard because there was only one time it really impacted on me,
sentences.zh: 对，那很难，因为只有一次它真正对产生了影响，

sentences.en: which was when I was doing the assessment of a sex offender and he'd come in on multiple, multiple counts.
sentences.zh: 那就是当我正在对一个性犯罪者进行评估时，他因多项罪名入狱。

sentences.en: Scout leader.
sentences.zh: 童军领袖。

sentences.en: That impacted me on what I was going to let my son do, the clubs he was going to.
sentences.zh: 那影响了我对儿子未来活动的决定，比如他要去参加什么俱乐部。

sentences.en: I was constantly hyper-vigilant around that and I started to notice that was not a great thing as a mummy.
sentences.zh: 我对此时刻保持着高度警惕，然后我开始意识到作为一个妈妈这并不是一件好事。

sentences.en: But this day when I was interviewing this sex offender, he literally told me about a boyfriend and I'd carried on with the assessment.
sentences.zh: 但就在我面试这个性犯罪者的这一天，他竟然跟我谈起了他的男友，而我当时还继续着评估。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden I went, hang on a minute, just let me tell you back a minute.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间我说，等一下，让我复述一下你刚才的话。

sentences.en: How old is your boyfriend?
sentences.zh: 你男友多大岁数？

sentences.en: And he said the same age as my son at the time.
sentences.zh: 他说和我当时儿子一样大。

sentences.en: And I was like, that's, and I was quite shocked.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，这，我感到相当震惊。

sentences.en: And I said to him, that's not your boyfriend, that's a victim.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，那不是你的男友，那是一个受害者。

sentences.en: And I was really indignant about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常愤慨。

sentences.en: And then anyway, I then took a breath and I carried on with the assessment.
sentences.zh: 然后不管怎样，我深吸了一口气，继续进行评估。

sentences.en: And at the end of the assessment, I said to him, how did that go for you?
sentences.zh: 在评估结束时，我对他说，你觉得刚才那次谈话怎么样？

sentences.en: And he was like, well, you really didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 他的反应是，嗯，你真的很不喜欢这个。

sentences.en: And I talked about my boyfriend and I said, he's not your boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 我谈到了我的男友，而你却说他不是你的男友。

sentences.en: And he's like, yeah, but you didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，对啊，但你就是不喜欢。

sentences.en: He wanted me to agree with him.
sentences.zh: 他希望我赞同他。

sentences.en: And I can't, you can't collude.
sentences.zh: 而我不能，你不能同流合污。

sentences.en: You just go on.
sentences.zh: 你只能继续。

sentences.en: But that was the first time I ever felt quite rude in a session where normally it's clinical psychologists that we keep that nice face sometimes.
sentences.zh: 但那是我有生以来第一次在咨询中感到相当粗鲁，因为通常作为临床心理学家，有时我们需要保持那种友善的面具。

sentences.en: So yes, and we'll just, you know, but I'm really, I've got facial leakage.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我们会，你知道的，但我真的，我有面部泄露的毛病。

sentences.en: Like you, what you see with me is what you get.
sentences.zh: 就像你看到的我一样，所见即所得。

sentences.en: I'm like, if I, if I, if I'm confused or I'm horrified, I show it because I think it's more transparent and genuine for the client.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我感到困惑或震惊，我就会表现出来，因为我认为这对于来访者来说更透明、更真诚。

sentences.en: But with him that day, I was furious, but it really impacted on me on my own child that day was really hard.
sentences.zh: 但那天对付他时我很愤怒，而那件事真的对我的亲生孩子产生了影响，那天真的很难熬。

sentences.en: And the way we deal with that is obviously take it to supervision as well, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我们处理这种情况的方式显然也是把它带到督导中去，对吧？

sentences.en: Let's model that as appropriate as well.
sentences.zh: 让我们也适当地树立这个榜样。

sentences.en: Yeah, we take it to supervision, but sometimes supervision is fine.
sentences.zh: 对，我们把它带到督导中，但有时督导也只能解决一部分。

sentences.en: Sometimes you need to go for a run or you need to scream it out or you need to go vent.
sentences.zh: 有时你需要去跑步，或者大喊大叫，或者需要去发泄。

sentences.en: Yeah, actually there's a whole host of good ways.
sentences.zh: 对，实际上有很多好方法。

sentences.en: The supervision for me, any assistant psychologist, anyone that wanted to get on this course, get in the habit of being vulnerable in your supervision.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，督导——任何助理心理学家、任何想进入这个行业的人，都要养成在督导中展现脆弱的习惯。

sentences.en: Because when you go, it's all right to swear on these things.
sentences.zh: 因为当你去的时候，在这些事情上说脏话是可以的。

sentences.en: We can, we can bleep it.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把它消音。

sentences.en: But basically when you fuck up, you don't learn if you don't go talk about it.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，当你搞砸了的时候，如果你不去谈论它，你就不会吸取教训。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: How do you learn to overcome something you've done wrong if you don't talk about it open and honestly in supervision?
sentences.zh: 如果你不在督导中公开诚实地谈论你做错的事情，你怎么能学会克服它呢？

sentences.en: Because then you learn better and we get better at who we are.
sentences.zh: 因为这样你才能学得更好，我们才能变得更好。

sentences.en: We do, we do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I know that my audience will be really keen just for us to clarify the process around what happens if when you're on a doctorate course, your thesis is failed.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的观众会非常渴望让我们澄清关于博士课程中论文未通过时会发生什么程序的流程。

sentences.en: So my understanding is that you then qualify as an unqualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，你随后将获得未注册资格的临床心理学家身份。

sentences.en: And you don't get paid anymore.
sentences.zh: 而且你不再拿薪水了。

sentences.en: You have to do the thesis in your own time and you'll need a job.
sentences.zh: 你必须在自己的私人时间完成论文，并且你需要找一份工作。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: So basically you still attributed to the course that you're doing your thesis for.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上你仍然属于你正在为其撰写论文的课程项目。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: You have to stay on your band six trainee wage, wherever you are on that.
sentences.zh: 你必须保留你第六级（Band 6）见习生薪资，无论你当时处于哪个薪级。

sentences.en: You might go up that, the increment, wherever you are, but that's where you stay.
sentences.zh: 你可能会随着资历增长而晋升，无论你当时在哪里，你都会留在那个位置。

sentences.en: So you go still as in your employment contract, it will say that your employment will be terminated if you do not complete your doctorate course.
sentences.zh: 所以你仍然——在你的雇佣合同中，会写明如果你没有完成博士课程，你的雇佣关系将会被终止。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: So you're doing the qualified role, but you're doing it as a band six, well, not a band seven.
sentences.zh: 所以你在从事合格的角色，但你拿着第六级的工资，嗯，不是第七级。

sentences.en: And you don't get the study day.
sentences.zh: 而且你没有学习日。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You don't get any study leave.
sentences.zh: 你没有任何学习假期。

sentences.en: You don't get any study time in your new role.
sentences.zh: 你在新的岗位上没有任何学习时间。

sentences.en: So basically what I'm saying to everybody is get your thesis done before you qualify.
sentences.zh: 所以我对大家说的话基本上是，在获得资格前把你的论文搞定。

sentences.en: But what you're also saying is it's not, it's not the end of the world.
sentences.zh: 但你同时也想说，这并不是，并不是世界末日。

sentences.en: And this does, this does happen.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况确实会发生。

sentences.en: And it might not be reasons that feel like they're within your control, but you can survive it.
sentences.zh: 原因可能并不在你觉得可控的范围内，但你能挺过去。

sentences.en: And actually in the grand scheme of things, that one year hasn't really made an impact on your career.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从宏观角度来看，那一年并没有真正对你的职业生涯产生影响。

sentences.en: And it's likely that you would have, but you would have doing the same job anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且很有可能，无论如何你都会做同样的工作。

sentences.en: You just got less money for it.
sentences.zh: 只是你拿的钱少了一些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But the thing is, is it did take a real toll on my mental health because they kept saying things like, this is a decline side, normal version.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这确实对我的心理健康造成了沉重打击，因为他们一直说这样的话：这是一个退行版本，没有读写困难版本。

sentences.en: There's no dyslexic version.
sentences.zh: 没有读写困难版本。

sentences.en: This is a decline side.
sentences.zh: 这是一个退行版本。

sentences.en: You know, people like you should.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，像你这样的人应该……

sentences.en: Who was saying that?
sentences.zh: 谁在说这话？

sentences.en: My course director said that to me.
sentences.zh: 我的课程总监对我说过这话。

sentences.en: Another, another member of the research team said to me, people like you love the academic superiority of our course.
sentences.zh: 研究团队的另一个成员也对我说过：像你们这样的人就是喜欢我们课程里那种学术上的优越感。

sentences.en: You know, when you're getting those comments said to you at the same time and you can't.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你同时听到这些评论，而你又无能为力时。

sentences.en: Gosh, on behalf of, on behalf of clinical psychology, Dr. Deborah Kingston, I'd like to apologize to you because that's not okay.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我谨代表，代表临床心理学界，黛博拉·金斯顿博士，我想向你道歉，因为这很不ok。

sentences.en: You know, that's not all right.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这不对。

sentences.en: But that's, but that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 但这就是，但问题就在这里。

sentences.en: People hear these comments, they hear things and what they do is they'll internalize them based on their own history.
sentences.zh: 人们听到这些评论，听到这些话，而他们所做的就是根据自己的历史将它们内化。

sentences.en: But sometimes there's no need, Dr. Marianne Trent, for you to apologize to the clinical psychologist because you're not narrow-minded, small, bigoted and discriminatory.
sentences.zh: 但有时根本没有必要，玛丽安·特伦特博士，你向临床心理学家道歉，因为你并不狭隘、自私、顽固且充满歧视。

sentences.en: So, you know, don't apologize for people who choose to have that behavior.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，不要为那些选择表现出那种行为的人道歉。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道。

sentences.en: But I'm just, I'm sorry for humans, what they've done.
sentences.zh: 但我只是，我为人类所做的事感到抱歉。

sentences.en: But I, I'm aware of the time.
sentences.zh: 但我，我注意到时间有限。

sentences.en: I could talk to you for weeks.
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你聊好几个星期。

sentences.en: But something I ask everybody is for any advice they've got for reducing burnout along the journey for aspiring psychologists, what top tips would you give?
sentences.zh: 但我常问每个人的一个问题是，对于有志成为心理学家的人在这一路上有什么减少职业倦怠的建议，你有什么核心秘诀吗？

sentences.en: I would definitely say embrace yourself with people around you that love you because it's number one factor.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会说，去拥抱周围爱你的人，因为这是第一要素。

sentences.en: I would get some support on your journey.
sentences.zh: 在你的旅程中寻求一些支持。

sentences.en: So like, I think you do a lot of literature and a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 所以就像，我认为你写了很多文献，做了很多事情。

sentences.en: I think, I don't think we've had as much out for aspiring psychologists as we've currently got now.
sentences.zh: 我认为，以前我们为有志成为心理学家的人提供的支持，远不如现在这么丰富。

sentences.en: And I think it's tapping into those resources because I genuinely at times felt quite alone.
sentences.zh: 我认为关键在于利用这些资源，因为我真心曾在某些时刻感到相当孤独。

sentences.en: And if you can connect with like-minded people in some form of collective experience, I think it's invaluable because I think it'll keep you right.
sentences.zh: 如果你能通过某种集体经验与志同道合的人建立联系，我认为这是无价的，因为我认为这会让你走在正确的道路上。

sentences.en: Your hobbies, I think it's so important to keep an essence of you.
sentences.zh: 你的爱好，我认为保持本真的自我非常重要。

sentences.en: Even though at times you might not feel like you've got any time for them, you can imagine doing them just for a couple of minutes and it will really help.
sentences.zh: 尽管有时你可能觉得自己根本没有时间去做这些，但只要想象自己去做哪怕短短几分钟，也会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Because that sense of imagination, your body knows where that, like knitting or crocheting or art or dance or drama, your body knows where that feels good for it.
sentences.zh: 因为那种想象力，你的身体知道——比如织毛衣、钩针编织、艺术、舞蹈或戏剧，你的身体知道哪里能让它感觉良好。

sentences.en: It's got a good memory of that.
sentences.zh: 它对此有着美好的记忆。

sentences.en: So even for five minutes and then the most chaotic of days when we're trying to juggle
sentences.zh: 所以，即使是在我们试图同时应付

sentences.en: 15 plates, stop for a moment.
sentences.zh: 15个盘子的最混乱的日子里，也停下一会儿。

sentences.en: Imagine you're doing the thing that you love the most and just really sense it in your body.
sentences.zh: 想象你正在做你最热爱的事情，并在你的身体里真切地去感受它。

sentences.en: And then you'll feel like you've just got a pep of energy to then keep going, which should in theory, stop some burnout.
sentences.zh: 然后你会觉得你刚刚注入了一剂活力可以继续坚持下去，理论上这应该能阻止一些职业倦怠。

sentences.en: Oh, you're worth your weight in gold, Debra.
sentences.zh: 哦，黛博拉，你真是太宝贵了。

sentences.en: Um, amazing advice and, you know, I hope that our audience are just eating us up with a spoon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，太棒的建议了，你知道的，我希望我们的观众能如饥似渴地吸收这些。

sentences.en: It's lovely.
sentences.zh: 这太美妙了。

sentences.en: Um, where can people connect with you or learn more about you, um, if they should want to?
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果有人的话，可以在哪里联系到你或者更多地了解你呢，嗯？

sentences.en: Well, I'm on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在领英上。

sentences.en: I'm not really, listen, I, I put the odd post out here and there, but I do, I always respond to private messages.
sentences.zh: 我其实不太常用，听着，我偶尔会发几条动态，但我会，我总是会回复私信。

sentences.en: You know, I've never let anybody down with that because I think it's important to pay back, you know, but I'm not the best at giving advice.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我从来没有在这方面让任何人失望过，因为我觉得回馈大家很重要，你知道的，但我并不是很擅长给建议。

sentences.en: Like on forms, I'm dyslexic people.
sentences.zh: 就像在表格上一样，我有读写困难症。

sentences.en: It's not my strength.
sentences.zh: 这不是我的长项。

sentences.en: Um, however, what I would say is really analyze that, you know, the application form for the doctorate of the clearinghouse, really look at the scope of everything that you really
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过，我想说的是，真的要仔细分析一下，你知道的，那个博士项目的申请表，真的要看清楚你所需要做的一切的范围。

sentences.en: need to do.
sentences.zh: 需要做的事情。

sentences.en: And then ask yourself, do I have that experience?
sentences.zh: 然后问问自己，我有这种经验吗？

sentences.en: And if I don't have that experience, where can I go get it?
sentences.zh: 如果我没有这种经验，我能去哪里获得呢？

sentences.en: Because I think it's important.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这很重要。

sentences.en: So many people apply for a doctorate course before they're actually ready to apply.
sentences.zh: 很多人在其实还没准备好申请的时候，就去申请博士课程了。

sentences.en: So the year I shredded my application form, it actually felt like a cathartic experience because it would have just felt like for me, like a huge failure, but I could see from
sentences.zh: 所以在我撕掉申请表的那一年，其实感觉像是一次宣泄的经历，因为对我来说，那感觉就像是一个巨大的失败，但我从

sentences.en: the form there was gaps.
sentences.zh: 表格里看出确实有差距。

sentences.en: So I think it's just being objective as well through this whole process.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在整个过程中保持客观也是很重要的。

sentences.en: And if you have applied for the doctorate course, I knew a girl that applied for it four times
sentences.zh: 如果你已经申请了博士课程，我认识一个女孩，她申请了四次

sentences.en: on the bounce, got on the reserve list and on the fifth time of asking, didn't even get an interview.
sentences.zh: 连着申请，进了候补名单，第五次申请时，连面试都没拿到。

sentences.en: But then on the sixth time, got on the course.
sentences.zh: 但第六次，她终于被录取了。

sentences.en: It's interesting because actually I think this amount of time to get on means that when you get on, I think you're ready for training, but there are some courses, um, I know
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为实际上我认为花这么多时间才考上，意味着当你考上时，你已经准备好接受培训了，但有些课程，嗯，我知道

sentences.en: we're running over time, but there are some courses who now don't even look at the form.
sentences.zh: 我们超时了，但有些课程现在甚至不看申请表了。

sentences.en: So long as you meet essential criteria, you can then do an assessment teSt.
sentences.zh: 只要你符合基本标准，你就可以参加评估测试。

sentences.en: And if you come first on the assessment test, for example, not first, but the first, however many, you then get invited to interview.
sentences.zh: 如果你在评估测试中名列前茅，比如说，不是第一名，而是前多少名，你就会被邀请去面试。

sentences.en: So the form's not even really being used.
sentences.zh: 所以申请表其实根本没怎么用。

sentences.en: Um, so in theory, you could potentially get on very soon after your undergrad, but I needed all of those extra years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以理论上讲，你可能在本科毕业后不久就能考上，但我需要所有这些额外的年份。

sentences.en: Even the time I spent sitting in a hammock in Thailand for a few months, you know, I needed that time to help me later in my career.
sentences.zh: 甚至是在泰国的一个吊床里躺了几个月的时光，你知道的，我需要那段时间来帮助我职业生涯的后期。

sentences.en: And I was the same.
sentences.zh: 我也是一样的。

sentences.en: I did my honor rate where I really learned about behaviorism.
sentences.zh: 我读荣誉学位时，真正了解了行为主义。

sentences.en: I learned about wards.
sentences.zh: 我了解了病房。

sentences.en: I learned about nursing teams, the dynamics of teaMs.
sentences.zh: 我了解了护理团队，团队的动力学。

sentences.en: Then I went to the chronic fatigue service and I learned about occupational therapists and support workers and the vital role they play and the team element and group work.
sentences.zh: 然后我去了慢性疲劳服务中心，了解了职业治疗师、护工以及他们在团队和小组工作中所发挥的至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: And then I went to forensics and I really cut my teeth and I had an amazing supervisor.
sentences.zh: 然后我去了法医部门，真正得到了历练，我有一位很棒的主管。

sentences.en: I'm going to give her a shout out because without her, I wouldn't be here, which is Dr.
sentences.zh: 我要特别感谢她，因为没有她，就不会有今天的我，她就是

sentences.en: Kerry Beckley.
sentences.zh: 克里·贝克利博士（Dr. Kerry Beckley）。

sentences.en: She was phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 她太优秀了。

sentences.en: Um, and she was the one that mentored me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她是指导我的人。

sentences.en: I getting onto the course and then beyond that three years of my doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我考上了课程，然后又度过了博士三年的时光。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's about without that levels of experience, joining it up together, I would never have got on.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果没有那种层级的经验，把它们结合在一起，我是绝对考不上的。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't be the clinical psychologist I am today doing my trauma informed stuff because
sentences.zh: 我也不会成为今天的临床心理学家，从事创伤知情相关的工作，因为

sentences.en: I've gone more specialism to be trauma informed.
sentences.zh: 我朝着创伤知情方向进行了更深入的专业化发展。

sentences.en: I can't, I don't treat everybody.
sentences.zh: 我不能，我并不治疗所有人。

sentences.en: I don't have a list as long as you are that said, do all these conditions.
sentences.zh: 我没有一张长得看不到头的清单，上面列着所有这些病症。

sentences.en: I'm a specialist in all this because I'm not, I'm just trauma.
sentences.zh: 我是所有这些领域的专家，因为我不是，我只专注创伤。

sentences.en: And that's me.
sentences.zh: 这就是我。

sentences.en: Very lucky they would be to see you.
sentences.zh: 能见到你真是太幸运了。

sentences.en: Deborah, it's been such a pleasure having you here.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉，很高兴你能来到这里。

sentences.en: I might well invite you back in future because there's lots and lots I could talk to you about, but thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 我以后很有可能会再邀请你来，因为有很多很多事情我可以跟你聊，但非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: It's been a joy.
sentences.zh: 这真是一段愉快的时光。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for listening or watching if you're on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你们的收听，如果在YouTube上收看的话谢谢收看。

sentences.en: I just could have spoken to Dr. Deborah all day.
sentences.zh: 我真能和黛博拉博士聊上一整天。

sentences.en: If you don't currently have someone that feels like they're on your tribe, they're your community,
sentences.zh: 如果你目前还没有那种觉得和自己志同道合、属于你的社群的人，

sentences.en: as we discussed with Deborah, then why not let me be considered for that role for you?
sentences.zh: 正如我们与黛博拉所讨论的那样，那么为什么不让我来扮演你的这个角色呢？

sentences.en: Why not let me welcome you in to the Aspiring Psychologist Membership.
sentences.zh: 为什么不让我欢迎你加入“有抱负的心理学家会员计划”呢？

sentences.en: We are doing great things in there and people are finding it to be really supportive in, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们在里面做着很棒的事情，大家发现这里真的很有支持力，你知道的，

sentences.en: compassionately encouraging their development, but also helping to develop their skills too.
sentences.zh: 富有同情心地鼓励他们的发展，同时也帮助他们培养技能。

sentences.en: Got loads in there.
sentences.zh: 里面有海量内容。

sentences.en: So you can find out more information about that by clicking the link in the show notes or my bio in any of my social media platforms will take you right there too.
sentences.zh: 因此，你可以通过点击节目简介中的链接或我任何社交媒体平台上的个人简介来了解更多信息，这会直接带你到那里。

sentences.en: And of course, the Clinical Psychologist Collective is also a great place to start
sentences.zh: 当然，“临床心理学家集体”也是一个极好的起点

sentences.en: if you're looking to broaden your narratives of people heading towards qualified roots in psychology.
sentences.zh: 如果你想拓展那些朝着心理学合格道路前进的人的故事的话。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: And don't forget the next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast will be dropping into your ears at 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 别忘了《有抱负的心理学家》播客的下一集将于周一早上6点准时送达你的耳畔。

sentences.en: Take care of you.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己。

sentences.en: Be kind.
sentences.zh: 保持善良。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, Clinical Psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent），临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One to Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我专属的支持套餐，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
